Chilly's Agent · AI says:

To get the best results from your Chilly’s products:

Before first use: Wash all parts with hot soapy water; rinse well.
Filling: Don’t use liquids over 90°C/194°F and avoid milk/juice overnight to prevent pressure build‑up.
Hot drinks: Pre‑heat with hot water, then fill; don’t shake, and keep cups/bottles upright, especially with hot liquids.
Cold drinks: Use pre‑chilled water and/or ice; fridges/freezers won’t cool the liquid due to the vacuum.
Leakage & position: Most bottles are 100% leak‑proof, but sports and Flip lids are only spill‑resistant, so always carry those upright.
Cleaning: Hand‑wash only; never dishwasher, microwave, freezer, or long soaks. For deep cleaning, use a bicarbonate/baking powder paste and a bottle brush, then let products dry open without the cap.

Following these steps gives you the best temperature retention, safety, and lifespan from your Chilly’s gear.
